info.title: Driver API
info.description: API for interacting with the Driver.dev browser network.

Bearer.description: A workspace API key from Settings → API keys in the dashboard (https://app.driver.dev), sent as a bearer token.

included_network_mb.description: Network traffic included with the plan, in megabytes.

overage_millicents_per_mb.description: Network overage rate in millicents per megabyte; 1,000 millicents equals one cent.

concurrent_browsers.description: Concurrent browser allowance provided by the plan.

max_session_seconds.description: Maximum duration of one browser session, in seconds.

BillingPlan.description: Current plan, or null for an unmigrated legacy account.

start_ms.description: Current billing period start as Unix epoch milliseconds.

end_ms.description: Current billing period end as Unix epoch milliseconds.

included_network_mb.description: Network traffic included in this billing period, in megabytes.

network_mb_used.description: Metered network traffic used during this billing period, in megabytes.

network_mb_remaining.description: Included network traffic remaining in this billing period, in megabytes.

BillingPeriod.description: Current usage period, or null for an unmigrated legacy account.

balance_cents.description: Available wallet balance in cents. This can be negative when usage exceeds prepaid credit.

balance_millicents.description: Available wallet balance in millicents for exact billing calculations; 1,000 millicents equals one cent.

current_period_start.description: Subscription period start as Unix epoch milliseconds.

current_period_end.description: Subscription period end as Unix epoch milliseconds.

cancel_at_period_end.description: Whether the subscription is scheduled to cancel at the end of its current period.

BillingSubscription.description: Current subscription, or null when the account has no subscription.

orgId.description: WorkOS organization ID. Null for an unmigrated legacy account.

status.description: Billing account status. Legacy accounts return `legacy`.

post.description: Create a browser session and wait for CDP readiness. hosted, hosted_stealth, and hosted_privacy are hosted browsers; hosted_stealth applies the conservative stealth policy and hosted_privacy the aggressive one. Hosted Canadian sessions without an explicit proxy use TCPerfect. Country defaults to US; omitted locale and proxy values are resolved coherently.

nodeId.description: The ID of the node to create a session on. Optional. If not provided, a random node will be selected. If provided, it takes precedence over country and type.

country.description: Two-letter country code used for placement and locale coherence. Defaults to US unless a SOCKS5 URL is supplied with neither language nor timezone, in which case Driver derives the country from the proxy exit. A supplied country must match that resolved exit. Driver otherwise selects a plausible primary language and dominant regional timezone.

type.description: Browser execution class. hosted is the native browser, hosted_stealth applies the conservative stealth policy, and hosted_privacy the aggressive one. Defaults to hosted.

url.description: Initial URL opened by the browser after launch. Optional. Opened right after launch.

proxyUrl.description: Explicit SOCKS5, SOCKS5H, or TCPerfect network URL for the session. A SOCKS URL supplied without language or timezone is geolocated before launch; Driver derives or validates country and uses the exit timezone. When omitted, hosted Canadian sessions use a uniformly selected public address from the production TCPerfect inventory.

windowSize.description: Outer browser-window size in WIDTHxHEIGHT format. Width must be 320–16384 and height 200–16384.

displaySize.description: Virtual display size in WIDTHxHEIGHT format. Width must be 320–16384 and height 200–16384.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for the browser. It must be listed for the selected country. When omitted, Driver selects a dominant regional timezone and, where Driver runs a managed network there, routes the session through that region.

language.description: BCP-47 browser language listed for the selected country. US sessions accept only en-US and omit both language launch fields so the browser uses its built-in en-US default. For other countries, Driver deterministically chooses the likely primary language the browser supports. Hosted sessions provision matching TTS when available; otherwise Web Speech is disabled for coherence.

duration.description: The duration of the browser session in seconds. Optional. Default is 3600 seconds (1 hour). Cannot be greater than 3600 seconds (1 hour). Cannot be less than 60 seconds (1 minute).

name.description: The name of the browser profile.

persist.description: Whether to save the browser profile from this session after its completed.

profile.description: A named full browser profile. Persistent profiles are kept between sessions.

adblock.description: Whether to enable ad-blocking in the browser session. Optional. Default is false.

captchaSolver.description: Whether to enable the built-in CAPTCHA solver for the session. Optional. Default is false.

extensionIds.description: Internal extension IDs returned by the extensions API. Requires account-level extension access.

browserCheck.description: Whether to run a browser validation check during session creation. Optional. Default is false.

note.description: An optional note to attach to the session. Maximum 256 characters.
note.example: Scraping product pages for client X

sessionId.description: The ID of the created browser session.

servedBy.description: The node ID that is serving this session.

createdAt.description: The ISO 8601 timestamp when the session was created.

stoppedAt.description: The ISO 8601 timestamp when the session was stopped, or null if it is still active.

cdpUrl.description: The URL to access the Chrome DevTools Protocol for this session, or null if not available.

note.description: An optional note attached to the session, or null if not set.

400.description: Invalid country, language, timezone, dimensions, proxy, type, or incompatible option combination.

500.description: Failed to create a browser session.

504.description: A machine was selected but the browser did not become CDP-ready before the startup deadline.

get.description: Returns the authenticated account’s complete billing summary, including its plan limits, current usage period, available wallet balance, and subscription state. Organization accounts use Driver Billing data. Unmigrated legacy accounts return their wallet balance with `plan`, `period`, and `subscription` set to null.

200.description: Complete billing details for the authenticated account.

500.description: Billing details could not be returned.

post.description: Upload a Chrome extension ZIP file. The extension will be packed into CRX format and made available for use in browser sessions. Requires account-level allowlist access — returns 403 if your account is not enabled.

extension.description: The ZIP file containing the Chrome extension.

extensionId.description: The internal extension ID (use this when referencing extensions in session creation).

createdAt.description: The ISO 8601 timestamp when the extension was created.

updatedAt.description: The ISO 8601 timestamp when the extension was last updated.

403.description: Extensions API is not enabled for this account. Contact support to request access.

get.description: List all uploaded extensions. Requires account-level allowlist access.

extensionId.description: The internal extension ID (use this when referencing extensions in session creation).

createdAt.description: The ISO 8601 timestamp when the extension was created.

updatedAt.description: The ISO 8601 timestamp when the extension was last updated.

403.description: Extensions API is not enabled for this account. Contact support to request access.
